fact: Burundi's national AI strategy, presented at its validation workshop, provides for a national AI commission, an ethics charter and regulatory adaptation.

The national AI strategy validated on 21-22 April 2026 with UNDP provides for creating a National AI Commission (CNIA) and a Strategic Intelligence Centre under its governance axis, which also covers ethics and compliance.
